headline: Names a Seminole, Florida post office building after Army Staff Sergeant Ryan Christian Knauss.
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 9355 113th Street in Seminole, Florida. The building will be called the Army SSG Ryan Christian Knauss Memorial Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025, and the naming took effect on that date.
